label: Part 01
text: In the Far East there was a Great King who had no work to do. Every day, and all day long, he sat on soft cushions and listened to stories. And no matter what the story was about, he never grew tired of hearing it, even though many of the stories took hours to complete. "There is only one fault with your story," he often said, "it is too short." All the storytellers in the world were invited to his palace; and some of them told stories that were very long indeed.
